paragraphs: R. Yehudah ben Gurya, R. Eliezer's student. He ruled before his teacher R. Eliezer. R. Eliezer told his wife Imma Shalom that he would not complete his year, and so it was; see there. R. Chiyya bar Ba said: R. Yudan bar Giraya waters using a basket—Jerusalem Sheviit 2:3:5 (halakhah 4 in Heilprin).
